parts.text: Evaluate this alternative way of studying the Oedipus complex in practical and ethical terms.

text: Freud conducted a case study to investigate the development of the Oedipus complex in little Hans.
An alternative way to investigate this would be to conduct a self report into childhood sexuality.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: What is meant by the ‘social approach’ in psychology?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe one finding from the study that supports a situational explanation of helping
behaviour.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Discuss the strengths and weaknesses of the social approach using the Piliavin et al. study
as an example.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Compare the social approach with one other approach in psychology using the Piliavin et al.
study and any other study as examples. 
Section B (20 marks)
Answer one question from this section.

text: Piliavin et al. (subway Samaritans) investigated helping behaviour on a busy subway.

parts.text:
Outline what is meant by the ‘cognitive approach’ in psychology. 
Using the studies from the list below, answer the questions which follow:
Loftus and Pickrell (false memories)
Held and Hein (kitten carousel)
Mann et al. (lying)

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe how the data were collected in each of these studies.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: What problems may psychologists have when they investigate cognitive processes?

Langlois et al. (infant facial preference)

debate.
